tools.name: get_native_balance
tools.description: Get the native coin (e.g. ETH) balance of an address, in wei.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Get the list of normal (external) transactions for an address.

tools.name: get_internal_transactions
tools.description: Get internal transactions for an address, or by a specific parent transaction hash.

tools.name: get_token_transfers
tools.description: Get token transfer events for an address, optionally filtered by token contract. Select the token standard: erc20 (fungible, default), erc721 (NFT), or erc1155 (multi-token).

tools.name: get_contract_source
tools.description: Get the verified source code and metadata for a contract address.

tools.name: get_contract_abi
tools.description: Get the verified ABI (JSON) for a contract address.

tools.name: get_contract_creation
tools.description: Get the creator address and creation transaction hash for up to 5 contract addresses. The multi-kilobyte creation bytecode is omitted by default to keep responses small; set include_creation_bytecode=true to include it.

tools.name: get_transaction_receipt_status
tools.description: Get the receipt status of a transaction (1 = success, 0 = failed). Post-Byzantium only.

tools.name: get_transaction_status
tools.description: Get the contract execution status of a transaction (detects failed/erroring executions).

tools.name: get_gas_oracle
tools.description: Get current gas price recommendations (safe / propose / fast) from the gas tracker.

tools.name: get_block_by_timestamp
tools.description: Get the block number closest to a given Unix timestamp (seconds).

tools.name: get_supported_chains
tools.description: Get the chains / chain IDs supported by the Etherscan V2 API. In the hosted (proxy) deployment this returns a bundled snapshot shipped with the server, refreshed when the package is updated; in direct/stdio mode it queries the live chain-list endpoint. A chain's absence from the returned list is not

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Search event logs by contract address and/or topics over a block range. Topics are 32-byte hex values; topic0 is usually the keccak256 event-signature hash. Adjacent-topic operators (and/or) combine multiple topic filters. Provide 'address' and/or at least one topic.

tools.name: get_transaction_by_hash
tools.description: Get the full transaction object for a transaction hash (from, to, value, input data, gas, gas price, nonce, block number/hash, transaction index). Returns null if the hash is unknown.

tools.name: get_transaction_receipt
tools.description: Get the transaction receipt for a transaction hash (execution status, gas used, cumulative gas used, effective gas price, logs, and the created contract address for deployments). Returns null if the hash is unknown or the transaction is still pending.

tools.name: render_etherscan_widget
tools.description: Present exact facts returned by Etherscan data tools in a fast explorer-style card. Call the relevant Etherscan data tool first and copy only supported values into this tool. Never invent scores, risk labels, historical prices, forecasts, or audit conclusions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transaction_receipt_status · Private data: get_token_transfers · Public sink: get_transaction_receipt_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transaction_receipt_status · Private data: get_token_transfers · Public sink: get_transaction_receipt_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
